metadata.case_name: LEE SAU FAT v. F. H. SECURITY SERVICES COMPANY LIMITED

injuries.description: sprain of back resulting in residual back pain
source: Form 7 for “sprain of back resulting in residual back pain” issued on 22nd April 2009 assessed the sick leave period to be from 7th to 10th May 2005 and the loss of earning capacity to be 0.5%.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

source: On 7th May 2005, whilst on duty she slipped and fell from a stool and injured her right wrist and loin (“1st Accident”).
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the wrist or hand, unspecified

injuries.description: bilateral knee injury resulting in both knees pain, right knee fracture and stiffness
source: the relevant Form 7 issued on 3rd December 2008 for “(1) bilateral knee injury resulting in both knees pain, right knee fracture and stiffness, (2) psychiatric impairment, depression” assessed the sick leave period to be intermittent periods between 18th March 2006 and 20th May 2008, and the loss of earning capacity to be 17.6%.

injuries.description: soft tissue injury to right ankle
source: Dr Lam diagnosed Madam Lee’s orthopaedic injuries to be soft tissue injury to both knees and right ankle, which he opined were consistent with the mechanism of injury described "and …… likely to be caused by the subject accident" (my emphasis).
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of ankle, unspecified

injuries.description: degenerative arthritis of the right knee (pre-existing)
source: the picture from the arthroscopy was one of degenerative arthritis of the right knee which was pre-existing and the 2nd and 3rd Accidents were at best aggravating factors.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the knee or lower leg

injuries.description: psychiatric impairment, depression / major depressive episode – severe with psychotic features
source: the relevant Form 7 issued on 3rd December 2008 for "(1) bilateral knee injury resulting in both knees pain, right knee fracture and stiffness, (2) psychiatric impairment, depression"
Dr Ng's diagnosis was "major depressive episode – severe with psychotic features" and he opined that the 3rd Accident and its related stressors were the sole cause of the mental disorder.

manifestations.description: mentally unfit to work / unable to sustain employment
impairment and disability in both knees reducing work ability
marked to extreme mental symptoms impeding most useful functions

losses.description: Unable to return to previous job; mentally unfit to work / unable to sustain employment.
Impairment and disability in both knees reducing ability to perform job and mobility.
